summary: DeepSeek introduces the DeepSeek LLM family (7B and 67B, open-source), trained on a 2-trillion-token dataset and fine-tuned via SFT and DPO, reporting that the 67B model surpasses LLaMA-2 70B and GPT-3.5 on several benchmarks.

practices.reason: An engineering team evaluating open-source alternatives would consider DeepSeek LLM 67B given its stated wins over LLaMA-2 70B on code, math and reasoning and over GPT-3.5 in open-ended evaluation.
practices.quote: Our evaluation results demonstrate that DeepSeek LLM 67B surpasses LLaMA-2 70B on various benchmarks, particularly in the domains of code, mathematics, and reasoning.

practices.reason: The paper mentions open-ended evaluation methodology comparing chat models against GPT-3.5, which is a measurement approach worth noting but not detailed enough to adopt directly.
practices.quote: Furthermore, open-ended evaluations reveal that DeepSeek LLM 67B Chat exhibits superior performance compared to GPT-3.5.
